scale: A = a hook the house would print (rule-table technique, under 12 words a sentence, one surprise). B = works, could bite harder. C = plain or file-card. D = textbook, label or recap. F = breaks a rule (AD year, spoiler, opened box). Last line: the bold card must tease the next episode under 25 words, end on …! or a question, spend nothing, and be picked up by the next first line.
